'''Robert Lee Williams III''' (born October 17, 1997) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Texas A&M Aggies men's basketball|Texas A&M Aggies]].

== Career ==

=== High School ===
Williams attended [[North Caddo High School]] in [[Vivian, Louisiana]].<ref>[http://www.shreveporttimes.com/story/sports/2015/07/24/robert-williams-texas-basketball-recruiting-espn/30629611/ LeBron gives Robert Williams a passing lesson?]</ref> A consensus four-star recruit, he ranked 50th overall in [[ESPN]]’s Top 100 for the class of 2016<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.espn.com/college-sports/basketball/recruiting/player/_/id/211554/robert-williams|title=Robert Williams - Basketball Recruiting - Player Profiles - ESPN|website=ESPN.com|access-date=2017-07-18}}</ref> and was the number one prospect in the state of [[Louisiana]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.12thman.com/news/2015/11/11/MBB_1111152754.aspx|title=Texas A&M Signs Louisiana Standout Robert Williams|website=Texas A&M University Athletics Department|language=en|access-date=2017-07-18}}</ref> He committed to [[Texas A&M University]] to play college basketball.<ref>[http://www.nola.com/recruiting/index.ssf/2015/06/north_caddo_2016_forward_rober.html North Caddo 2016 forward Robert Williams commits to Texas A&M]</ref><ref>[http://www.houstonchronicle.com/sports/aggies/article/Texas-A-M-s-Robert-Williams-humble-amid-whirlwind-10802395.php Texas A&M's Robert Williams humble amid whirlwind rise]</ref>

=== College ===
In his first college game, he scored five points and had five blocks and seven rebounds.<ref>[https://sports.yahoo.com/news/texas-am-freshman-robert-williams-stock-is-soaring-after-strong-start-031411049.html Texas A&M freshman Robert Williams' stock is soaring after strong start]</ref><ref>[http://www.sportingnews.com/ncaa-basketball/news/robert-williams-scouting-report-texas-am-one-and-done-freshman-nba-draft-2017/1xyvddwg86mos1oc42bpzmp0h5 Texas A&M's Robert Williams has NBA scouts' hearts as darkhorse one-and-done]</ref> He was named [[Southeastern Conference|SEC]] Defensive Player of the Year and earned 2nd Team All-SEC honors<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.shreveporttimes.com/story/sports/college/2017/03/07/robert-williams-sec-defensive-player-year/98852388/|title=Robert Williams is SEC Defensive Player of the Year|work=shreveporttimes.com|access-date=2017-07-18|language=en}}</ref> after averaging 11.9 points and a team-high 8.2 rebounds per game as a freshman in 2016-17.

On March 21, despite being credited as a potential first round player, Williams decided to forgo the [[2017 NBA Draft]] and stay for another season at Texas A&M.<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://bleacherreport.com/articles/2698025-robert-williams-announces-return-to-texas-am-will-forego-2017-nba-draft|title=Robert Williams Announces Return to Texas A&M, Will Forgo 2017 NBA Draft|last=Nathan|first=Alec|work=Bleacher Report|access-date=2017-07-18|language=en-US}}</ref>

Following Texas A&M's loss in the [[2018 NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Tournament|2018 NCAA Men's Basketball Tournament]], Williams announced his intention to forgo his final two seasons of collegiate eligibility and declare for the [[2018 NBA Draft]], where he is expected to be a first round selection.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.shreveporttimes.com/story/sports/college/2018/03/23/former-north-caddo-star-robert-williams-turning-pro/454834002/|title=Former North Caddo star Robert Williams turning pro|access-date=2018-03-23|language=en-US}}</ref>
